description: This PHP class, 'TimesheetPeriodSubscriber', functions as an event subscriber within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It listens for HTTP request events and conditionally forwards or blocks requests related to time tracking and timesheet periods based on configuration settings. The class leverages several traits for utility functions and interacts with specific controller classes for handling timesheet period configuration.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that monitors HTTP requests to the timesheet-related paths. It enforces configuration checks and authorization by forwarding or blocking requests based on the timesheet period configuration status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the events this subscriber listens to, specifically the main request event with a priority of 100.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests. Checks whether the request URL pertains to the timesheet or related API. Depending on the system's timesheet period configuration status, it forwards the request to the configuration controller or throws an exception to block unauthorized access.
